world_layer_finding.finding: Every series in the register named 'world' is published by a United States agency and carries geography US or New Mexico. The world layer of the Observatory does not exist; what exists is a US layer under a world name.
world_layer_finding.consequence: The WORLD -> UNITED STATES -> NEW MEXICO chain the model needs is missing its first leg entirely. Any Dula claim about a world condition currently rests on US series plus cited reporting.

readings.claim: The bound held and the obvious pairing was wrong. Los Alamos County imports 10,491 workers — above Phase 8's floor of 9,390 — but the largest single origin is Santa Fe, not the county that sends out the greatest share of its own workers.
basis: LEHD LODES8 origin-destination, JT00 all jobs, 2022
Phase 8 bound from QWI 2024-Q4 and ACS B08007
readings.support: 18,206 jobs are located in Los Alamos County and 10,491 of them are held by people living elsewhere. Santa Fe supplies 24.4%, Bernalillo 9.1% and Rio Arriba 8.7%. Of Rio Arriba's own out-commuting, 17.9% goes to Santa Fe against 16.5% to Los Alamos.
readings.qualifications: LODES counts JOBS, not workers: a person holding two jobs is counted in each, so the in-commuter figure exceeds the number of in-commuting people by an unknown margin. The data is noise-infused for confidentiality and small cells are the least reliable. Its universe is UI-covered employment plus federal civilian, not the whole labour force. The reference year is 2022, so this is a structural observation and not a statement about 2026 conditions; the bridge is that a labour shed is set by where jobs and housing are, both of which move over years.
readings.rivals: The 2022 reference year predates both Phase 8 sources, so part of the gap between the bound and the measurement could be growth rather than the private-only undercount the bound was built on.
readings.geography: all 33 New Mexico counties, as ordered pairs

readings.decisive_unknown: how many PEOPLE, as distinct from jobs, make each flow
readings.falsifier: a worker-based commuting matrix showing the person count is far below the job count would weaken every magnitude here without touching the direction
readings.status_means: held evidence supports it and nothing held materially opposes it

currency_bridge.means: describes a structure that changes slowly; it is not a statement about now
currency_bridge.bridge: A labour shed is a structure, not a conjuncture: it is set by where the jobs and the housing are, both of which move over years. The reading is about that structure and says so, and it is not a claim about 2026 employment levels.

readings.claim: Phase 8 refused to name Rio Arriba as the source of Los Alamos's workforce because nothing published supported it. The observation shows that refusal was right: the obvious pairing is real but it is not the largest one.
basis: LEHD LODES8 origin-destination, JT00 all jobs, 2022
readings.support: Santa Fe supplies 4,436 of the jobs located in Los Alamos County against Rio Arriba's 1,590. Torrance County, where Phase 8 called Albuquerque 'the obvious reading and not an observation', sends 46.7% of its working residents to Bernalillo. Mora sends 21 of its 1,157 to Los Alamos.
readings.qualifications: Two of the three obvious readings were right and one was wrong, which is the point: nothing in the prior evidence distinguished them. The same LODES limitations apply — jobs rather than people, noise-infused, 2022.
readings.rivals: With only one year observed, the ordering of Santa Fe and Rio Arriba could be a 2022 artefact rather than a stable structure.
readings.geography: Los Alamos, Rio Arriba, Santa Fe, Torrance and Mora counties

trace_example.claim: New Mexico's labour markets are not its counties. In the only part of the state where the data exists to check, one county imports at least 9,390 workers while its neighbours send 45% of theirs out.
mechanisms: People work at jobs located in Los Alamos County while living somewhere else, and travel to them.
Residents hold jobs outside their county of residence and commute.
Households move between counties inside the state within a year.
observations: QWI 2024-Q4 ownercode A05, private employers, nine counties
ACS B08007 2020-2024, place of work, same nine counties

trace_example.limitations_inherited: QWI counts private employers only, so government jobs are excluded and adding them could only raise the workplace count: 9,390 is a floor, not an estimate. The negative gaps for the other counties are uninterpretable for the same reason — a negative gap is what a missing public sector looks like, and Santa Fe is the state capital. The two sources are different universes over different periods, a quarter against five years.
trace_example.what_it_may_not_be_read_as: The gap could be filled by multiple job-holding rather than in-commuting, or by workers living in Los Alamos County who are missed by the ACS place-of-work universe.
